summary: A police chief tells a worried town that the people doing it mostly live somewhere else.
realLife: After a jump in home break-ins, a chief told residents at a special council meeting that such crimes are rare in the town and that most of those behind them come from elsewhere, and he praised residents who call in strangers and cameras that help.
